title: `SeedMask` does not uphold its own invariants
body:
`SeedMask` in `libsufr/src/format.rs` has five `pub` fields: `mask`, `bytes`, `positions`, `differences` and `weight`. The other four follow from `positions`, and a caller can change one without the rest. Nothing outside the unit tests reads `differences`.

`SeedMask::new` checks its string against `^1+0[01]*1$`. `SeedMask::from_bytes`, which `Header::read` calls on the mask stored in a file, checks none of that: it drops any byte other than 0 or 1, and it accepts a mask with no 0 or one that starts or ends with 0.

## Proposal

- `SeedMask` holds only the care positions, in a private field.
- `new` and `from_bytes` run one shared check.
- Callers read `positions()` and `weight()`. `len()` and `from_bytes` are crate-private.
- `differences` is removed.
- libsufr drops `regex`, which only the mask check used.

## Cost

Breaking for library code that reads the fields or calls `from_bytes`. The `.sufr` format does not change.
